facts.claim: A shooting star is a space rock entering the atmosphere; the bright streak is the glowing hot air around it.

source.title: NASA Space Place: What is a meteor shower?
source.quote: A meteor is a space rock—or meteoroid—that enters Earth's atmosphere. … That bright streak is not actually the rock, but rather the glowing hot air as the hot rock zips through the atmosphere.

facts.source_sentence: A meteor is a space rock—or meteoroid—that enters Earth's atmosphere. … That bright streak is not actually the rock, but rather the glowing hot air as the hot rock zips through the atmosphere.

facts.claim: When Earth meets many meteoroids at once, it is a meteor shower.

source.title: NASA Space Place: What is a meteor shower?
source.quote: When Earth encounters many meteoroids at once, we call it a meteor shower.

facts.source_sentence: When Earth encounters many meteoroids at once, we call it a meteor shower.
